contexts.text: The hanging for the court () = the truth of that Heaven. (For) curtains = truths; thus, also, the hanging.
The hangings for the court = the truths of the Ultimate Heaven. AC 9756. AC 9760.
Therefore the hangings of the wing towards the south = truths in light... and the hangings of the wing towards the north = truths in obscurity.
They adorned his chamber... with flowered hangings.
Representation... by the folding of a certain carpet, which is wont to lie under the feet; and which is folded up when interior things do not as yet appear...
There would then appear... like carpets or hangings most beautifully figured...
